text:
Ashley: Perf CI alert — small-seq (<=4 tokens) tail latency spike after merge abc1234 to runtime-main. Dashboard: https://perf.redwood.local/d/abcd/smallseq?orgId=1&panelId=7. Is this a rollout blocker?
perf-ci-bot: Alert: latency.p99_smallseq doubled vs baseline in nightly. CI job: runtime/perf/smallseq. Thresholds exceeded: p95,p99.
Raj: saw the alert. Quick glance at the histograms — 99.9th jumps from ~120ms -> ~280ms for seq<=4.
Taylor: starting bisect now, but quick hunch: stream-priority/affinity change landed in PR#456 (abc1234). That touched the scheduler and the kernel selector hint path.
Jia: grabbed a short profiler snapshot from a repro run on canary. Differences look like kernel dispatch and memcpy overhead.
Jia: ```
model=tiny-chat seq=2 batch=1
Before (commit def567):
  matmul_kernel_v1   48.1%
  kv_prefetch         4.3%
  memcpy              3.2%
After (abc1234):
  matmul_kernel_v3   61.7%  <-- different kernel path, worse for tiny batches
  kv_prefetch        12.8%  <-- more prefetch activity / eviction churn
  memcpy              9.6%  <-- extra host<->device copies observed
```
Ashley: ugh. So the selector picked a different kernel for tiny batches, causing more prefetch/eviction and memcpy. Any quick mitigation?
Raj: we can toggle the stream_affinity feature flag to false as a hotfix to restore previous selector behavior. Patch like: 
```
curl -X POST https://admin.redwood.local/flags -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"feature_flags": {"stream_affinity": false}}'
```
Taylor: I ran that locally against canary pool (reverted stream_affinity), and smallseq p99 dropped back near baseline in ~10m. Bisect points to commit abc1234 as the regression.
Taylor: repro steps I used: checkout abc1234, run `./scripts/perf_run --model tiny-chat --seq 2 --batch 1 --iters 200` then compare to main without the commit.
Jia: will open a revert PR to follow up and also add a smallseq kernel-selection unit test that asserts kernel path stability for len<=4 workloads. Assigning to Taylor to drive the PR.
deploy-bot: Canary revert deployed to canary pool at 3456789300.
Ashley: marking this as rollout-blocker, please coordinate with release for a full revert if the revert PR passes CI. Also call out to support — some customers on small bot flows may have seen regressions.
Raj: noted, adding #incidents if we get customer reports.
Taylor: filing the bisect/notes: https://git.redwood.local/runtime/+/3456789012-bisect-note — will attach profiler traces.
Ashley: thanks everyone :thumbsup: we should follow up with a proper root-cause (why selector chose matmul_v3) and consider adding a performance gate for kernel-selector changes.
